tags.name: TMinusSeconds
tags.documentation: Countdown clock, negative before T0, positive after. Frozen during holds.

tags.name: ClockRunning
tags.documentation: True while the count is advancing (false in holds, ABORT, IDLE).

tags.name: Phase
tags.documentation: Sequencer phase: IDLE|CHILLDOWN|LOADING|HOLD|TERMINAL_COUNT|IGNITION|LIFTOFF|ASCENT|ORBIT|ABORT|SAFING|RECYCLE.

tags.name: HoldReason
tags.documentation: Why the count is held (or the abort reason); empty otherwise.

tags.name: NextHoldAtSeconds
tags.documentation: T-minus of the next built-in hold still to come; 0 when none remain.

tags.name: CycleCount
tags.documentation: Number of countdowns started since the model was loaded.

tags.name: LaunchDirector
tags.documentation: Go/No-Go poll result for the LaunchDirector console (true = GO). Overridable through launch.set_go.

tags.documentation: Latched true after stage separation.

tags.documentation: Flight termination system armed (from T-1:00).

tags.name: Enabled
tags.documentation: Run the simulation. Writable.

tags.documentation: Scenario: nominal|hold_t40s|lox_leak_abort|weather_scrub. Use launch.set_scenario.

tags.name: ScenarioStep
tags.documentation: Scenario progress counter (0 = armed / not started).

tags.name: SpeedFactor
tags.documentation: Sim seconds per real second (a full cycle takes about 12-13 real minutes at 4).

tags.name: Seed
tags.documentation: Seed for the deterministic random streams.

tags.name: TickCount
tags.documentation: Timer ticks executed.

tags.name: LastTickMs
tags.documentation: Epoch milliseconds of the last tick; dt = SpeedFactor x elapsed real time.

tags.name: AutoCycle
tags.documentation: Restart the count automatically after RECYCLE. Writable.

tags.name: StartTMinus
tags.documentation: T-minus a new count starts at. Writable.

tags.name: LOXLeak
tags.documentation: LOX leak active (extra outflow, falling pressure).

tags.name: WeatherScrub
tags.documentation: Wind rising past the launch commit limit.

tags.name: LastError
tags.documentation: Last exception caught by the timer script; empty when healthy.

tags.name: Pending
tags.documentation: Command queue slot written by the launch library: START|RESUME|HOLD|ABORT|RECYCLE.

tags.name: Arg
tags.documentation: Argument for the pending command (T-minus seconds or reason text).

tags.documentation: Sim seconds spent in the active hold.

tags.documentation: Sim seconds all consoles have been GO during a hold.

tags.documentation: Vertical velocity.
